fields.label: Attachment Type
fields.description: What this paper is. The list is a table you can extend in Desk - no upgrade needed to add a type.

fields.label: Archive Location
fields.description: Where the paper original is filed. Optional: leave it empty rather than inventing a value.

fields.label: File
fields.description: The uploaded file. Its SHA-256 is recorded automatically and is checked whenever the record is verified.

fields.label: Secret Attachment
fields.description: Withholds this file's name from the overview and the print formats. Access to the file itself is governed by Frappe's File permissions, which follow the record.
